neural.rule: The LightGBM + BenchSniper ensemble must beat the current LightGBM projection on weekly fantasy-point MAE and RMSE, not reduce start/sit accuracy or top-50 precision, and not raise forward or defence weekly MAE by more than 0.5%, on both the validation and the untouched test season of the week-start backtest; and validation must give BenchSniper a non-zero weight.

promotion.rule: Selected projection must beat the production baseline on weekly fantasy-point MAE and RMSE, and not lose more than 0.005 in start/sit accuracy or top-50 precision, on both the validation and the untouched test season of the week-start weekly backtest.
